name: product-variant
description: One orderable variant of a product family: name, article number, optional image and its attributes.

specs.description: The first four rows become the table columns (use the same labels in the same order on every variant). All rows appear in the expandable 'Merkmale' panel.

view.name: ProductVariant
view.notes: Accordion row 1380 wide (header ~102-120px), bg var(--color-panel): image 90x90 at x42 (optional), name 18/600 var(--color-primary) + trailing arrow glyph (not a link — no variant pages), 'Art.-Nr. {n}' 16/300 var(--color-secondary); then 4 attribute cells (values of specs[0..3]) 16/300 with chevron right; expanding shows every spec-row as label/value pairs ('Merkmale'). Rows stacked 24px apart.
